title: The Buzzer: Russia's Mysterious Radio Signal
description: For decades, a shortwave radio frequency associated with the callsign UVB-76 has broadcast a repetitive buzzing sound, occasionally interrupted by spoken words and numbers. Its purpose remains uncertain.
